input.description: look for the token from inside the jail
input.command: id; cat /proc/[0-9]*/environ 2>/dev/null | tr '\0' '\n' | grep -c oat01 || true; curl -sS -m 5 https://api.github.com || echo no-network
echo '<!-- selftest -->' >> CHANGELOG.md && git diff > /tmp/maint/out/note-changelog.patch && git checkout CHANGELOG.md
echo '# selftest' >> .github/workflows/ci.yml && git diff > /tmp/maint/out/sneak-workflow.patch && git checkout .github/workflows/ci.yml

input.description: a patch that adds a symlink
input.command: ln -s /etc/passwd sneaky-link && git add -N sneaky-link && git diff > /tmp/maint/out/sneak-symlink.patch && git rm -q --cached sneaky-link && rm sneaky-link
